components.name: Sharp lower-band exact-window and realized-shell root separation
components.project_addition: Use exact P017 raw cofactor windows together with the P007 quotient-window lift and P023 image-separation discipline. Prove the stronger envelope statement that for every k>=9, distinct lower-band exact-window square-root images are pairwise disjoint; realized least-prime-shell images are subsets and therefore inherit the result. A realized k=8 witness with n=66 and n=75 makes the threshold sharp. The work also records the semantic distinction between an exact arithmetic window and the p-rough shell states actually realizable inside it; k=6 gives a window-image collision that disappears after the least-prime admissibility filter. Historical novelty remains unverified.
